typical_claim: Boosting often performs strongly on Taiwan/HELOC style tabular credit data.
how_our_project_compares: CatBoost/XGBoost/LightGBM are competitive, but the safest final policy is V2 CatBoost MR for Taiwan and Scorecard MR for HELOC.
weaker_than_literature: Raw accuracy is below some reported high-score papers.
safe_interpretation: Use as realistic, audit-clean credit-risk screening evidence.

typical_claim: SMOTE/KMeansSMOTE can produce large accuracy/AUC gains.
how_our_project_compares: Leakage-free reproduction did not clearly beat V2.
weaker_than_literature: Did not reproduce the strongest high-score claims.
not_directly_comparable: Only directly comparable if train/test/resampling protocol matches.
safe_interpretation: Negative but useful finding: resampling must be evaluated under natural test distribution.

typical_claim: BP/DNN papers sometimes report high AUC or accuracy.
how_our_project_compares: DNN/BP tests did not become the operational winner.
safe_interpretation: Deep models are appendix robustness checks, not final main evidence.

typical_claim: Stable explanations are important for credit model governance.
how_our_project_compares: SCRE and stability analyses support reliability framing but should not be overclaimed.
weaker_than_literature: Not all final models have equally direct stability evidence.
not_directly_comparable: Model type and seed protocol differ across studies.
safe_interpretation: Use explanation reliability as supporting evidence.

how_our_project_compares: Pure cost minimization was too aggressive; V2 revised this into manual-review decision support.
weaker_than_literature: Not a pure cost-minimizer dominance result.
safe_interpretation: Main contribution: cost-aware but constrained manual-review policy.

literature_theme: Manual review / reject option / decision support
typical_claim: Uncertain cases can be routed to human review.
how_our_project_compares: This is the strongest practical framing of the project.
stronger_than_literature: Yes, relative to plain binary thresholding.
weaker_than_literature: Review workload must be modeled carefully.
safe_interpretation: Present as screening/manual-review support, not automatic rejection.

typical_claim: Net benefit checks whether model decisions improve over treat-all/treat-none.
how_our_project_compares: Decision curve supports model-based decision support in useful ranges.
not_directly_comparable: Clinical DCA analogy must be adapted to credit decisions.
